findings.title: watch pause is tested only for a missing version, not a pre-0.30 one

Suggestion: Optionally add a 0.29.4 case to the watch test.

findings.title: init/upgrade exemption asserted only negatively
findings.detail:
The test only checks that init and upgrade do not return the guard's refusal. That fits 'each may refuse by its own check', and the handoff already says slices 03 and 04 must rewrite it to assert their own refusal.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Slices 03 and 04 assert the commands' own refusal there.
